checks.name: saved session is an exact nondefault snapshot in public storage
editing current setup does not mutate saved snapshot
refresh retains saved collection
refresh restores default stopped public state
explicit reload finds saved session
explicit load restores saved settings while remaining silent
rename retains the saved configuration and ID
save-as-copy creates an independent ID with the same settings
experimenting leaves both saved snapshots unchanged
explicit update changes original without changing copy
favorites view shows only favorited sessions
search filters the collection
export downloads a file
export contains the complete stored collection
delete removes the session from UI and storage
duplicate IDs are rejected without any storage mutation
